steps.name: What would you like to do?
notices: To allow the competent authorities to carry out optimization work on visa application procedures, visas on arrival and express visas are suspended until further notice.
Henceforth, visa applications must be submitted at least 5 days before arrival on Togolese territory.
All African nationals holding a valid passport may enter Togo without a visa for stays of up to 30 days, provided they have completed the immigration form at least 24 hours before arrival.
Enter Togo: Register your trip to enter Togo. A visa may be required depending on your nationality and the purpose of your trip.
Leave Togo: Register your departure from Togo. This procedure is required for all travelers leaving the country and does not require a visa.
